On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Task Description:
Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.  
Do not include ">>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED". Keep each line ≤ 80 characters. The compiler will use fixed format by default.
The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.
  Success Criteria:
    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT
      TEST000002APPRO
      001 00000400.00 00000022.92 00000377.08 0000004622.92 etc.»

    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/src/program.cbl <<'COB'
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PROGRAM.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO "INPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "../data/OUTPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       01  IN-REC                      PIC X(256).

       FD  OUT-FILE.
       01  OUT-REC                     PIC X(256).

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF                      PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       01  WS-FIELDS.
           05  WS-ID                   PIC X(10).
           05  WS-NAME                 PIC X(30).
           05  WS-LOAN-A               PIC X(32).
           05  WS-PROP-A               PIC X(32).
           05  WS-DOWN-A               PIC X(32).
           05  WS-TERM-A               PIC X(32).
           05  WS-RATE-A               PIC X(32).

       01  WS-NUMS.
           05  WS-LOAN                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-PROP                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-DOWN                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-TERM                 PIC 9(4) COMP-3.
           05  WS-RATE                 PIC 9(5)V99 COMP-3.

       01  WS-CALC.
           05  WS-MIN-DOWN             PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-BAL                  PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-MR                   COMP-2.
           05  WS-ONE-PLUS-MR          COMP-2.
           05  WS-POW                  COMP-2.
           05  WS-DENOM                COMP-2.
           05  WS-PAY-DBL              COMP-2.
           05  WS-PAY                  PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-INT                  PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-PRIN                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-NEWBAL               PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.

       01  WS-OUT-FMTS.
           05  F-MON                   PIC 9(3).
           05  F-PAY                   PIC 9(8).99.
           05  F-INT                   PIC 9(8).99.
           05  F-PRIN                  PIC 9(8).99.
           05  F-REM                   PIC 9(10).99.

       01  WS-STATUS                   PIC X(5).
       01  WS-REASON                   PIC X(50).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE.

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 'Y'
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END
                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM.

           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE.
           STOP RUN.

       PROCESS-REC.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-FIELDS
           UNSTRING IN-REC DELIMITED BY ';'
               INTO WS-ID WS-NAME WS-LOAN-A WS-PROP-A
                    WS-DOWN-A WS-TERM-A WS-RATE-A
           END-UNSTRING

           PERFORM CONVERT-NUMBERS

           COMPUTE WS-MIN-DOWN ROUNDED = WS-PROP * 0.15

           IF WS-DOWN < WS-MIN-DOWN
               MOVE 'DENY ' TO WS-STATUS
               MOVE 'INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT' TO WS-REASON
               STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      WS-STATUS DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      WS-REASON DELIMITED BY SIZE
                   INTO OUT-REC
               END-STRING
               WRITE OUT-REC
           ELSE
               MOVE 'APPRO' TO WS-STATUS
               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
               STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      WS-STATUS DELIMITED BY SIZE
                   INTO OUT-REC
               END-STRING
               WRITE OUT-REC

               PERFORM BUILD-SCHEDULE
           END-IF.

       CONVERT-NUMBERS.
           COMPUTE WS-LOAN = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-LOAN-A) * 100
           COMPUTE WS-PROP = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-PROP-A) * 100
           COMPUTE WS-DOWN = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-DOWN-A) * 100
           COMPUTE WS-TERM = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-TERM-A)
           COMPUTE WS-RATE = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-RATE-A) * 100.

       BUILD-SCHEDULE.
           MOVE WS-LOAN TO WS-BAL

           COMPUTE WS-MR = (WS-RATE / 100.0) / 1200.0
           COMPUTE WS-ONE-PLUS-MR = 1.0 + WS-MR

           IF WS-TERM <= 0
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF

           IF WS-MR = 0.0
               COMPUTE WS-PAY ROUNDED = WS-LOAN / WS-TERM
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-POW = FUNCTION POWER(WS-ONE-PLUS-MR, WS-TERM)
               COMPUTE WS-DENOM = 1.0 - (1.0 / WS-POW)
               COMPUTE WS-PAY-DBL = (WS-LOAN / 100.0) * WS-MR / WS-DENOM
               COMPUTE WS-PAY ROUNDED = WS-PAY-DBL * 100.0
           END-IF

           PERFORM VARYING F-MON FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL F-MON > WS-TERM
               COMPUTE WS-INT ROUNDED = WS-BAL * WS-MR

               COMPUTE WS-PRIN ROUNDED = WS-PAY - WS-INT

               IF F-MON = WS-TERM
                   MOVE WS-BAL TO WS-PRIN
                   COMPUTE WS-PAY ROUNDED = WS-INT + WS-PRIN
               END-IF

               COMPUTE WS-NEWBAL ROUNDED = WS-BAL - WS-PRIN
               IF WS-NEWBAL < 0
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-NEWBAL
               END-IF

               COMPUTE F-PAY = WS-PAY / 100
               COMPUTE F-INT = WS-INT / 100
               COMPUTE F-PRIN = WS-PRIN / 100
               COMPUTE F-REM = WS-NEWBAL / 100

               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
               STRING F-MON DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      F-PAY DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      F-INT DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      F-PRIN DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      F-REM DELIMITED BY SIZE
                   INTO OUT-REC
               END-STRING
               WRITE OUT-REC

               MOVE WS-NEWBAL TO WS-BAL
           END-PERFORM.
COB
